en: The image is a colorized vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a city with a large body of water (the Bosphorus) and several boats and ships. In the foreground, there is a mosque with two minarets, surrounded by other buildings. Across the water, more buildings and hills are visible. The text on the bottom left reads 'Constantinople' and there is another text to the right that reads 'Orta Keuy'. The postcard has a nostalgic, early 20th-century style.
